create.q: How do I design a custom T-shirt online?
create.a: Open the designer, pick your T-shirt or sweatshirt and its color, then add a design from our collection, your own image or some text. Adjust size and position, check the 3D preview and add it to your cart.

preview.q: Can I see my custom T-shirt before ordering?
preview.a: Yes. The designer shows a live 3D preview of your T-shirt or sweatshirt: turn it around to check the size, the position and the colors of your design, front and back, before adding it to the cart.

sides.q: Can I print on the front and the back?
sides.a: Yes. Place a design, a photo or a text on the front, on the back or on both sides of your T-shirt or sweatshirt, then check each side in the 3D preview.

upload.q: Which image formats can I upload for my T-shirt?
upload.a: PNG, JPG or SVG. For a sharp print, upload a large, high-resolution image. A PNG with a transparent background prints only your design, without a rectangle around it.

single.q: Can I order a single custom T-shirt?
single.a: Yes. Every piece is made to order: order a single T-shirt, or several sizes of the same design for a group, a team, a club or an event.

designs.q: What designs do you offer for my T-shirt?
designs.a: Our collection covers anime and manga, movies and series, music, retro and many other themes, and it keeps growing. Can't find what you want? Upload your own design, photo or logo in the designer.

range.q: Which T-shirts and colors can I customize?
range.a: A regular, oversize or washed T-shirt, in black or white, and a fleece sweatshirt for winter. Pick the base in the designer, then add an anime, retro, movie or music design, or your own.

delivery.q: How long does delivery take in Tunisia?
delivery.a: Your custom T-shirt is printed within 48 h, then delivered in 3 to 5 business days with standard delivery, or 1 to 2 business days with express. The courier calls you before coming.

payment.q: How do I pay for my order?
payment.a: You pay on delivery, when you receive your parcel: nothing is charged online when you order.

care.q: How do I care for my printed T-shirt?
care.a: Wash it inside out at 30 °C, avoid the tumble dryer and don't iron directly on the print: its colors stay bright for longer.

approved.text: Enter the activation code you received from our team to open your seller dashboard.

codeState.revoked: This code was withdrawn: ask our team for a new one.
codeState.expired: This code has expired: ask our team for a new one.

rejected.title: Your previous application wasn't accepted
rejected.again: You can update it and apply again.

seller.title: You're a seller
seller.text: Publish designs, manage your products and follow your earnings from your seller dashboard. Your customer account stays the same.

activated.title: Welcome, your seller account is active!

suspended.title: Your seller account is suspended
suspended.text: Your seller dashboard is closed for now. Your earnings are kept. Contact our team to know more.

errors.storeName: The store name must be 2 to 60 characters.
errors.description: The description must be 1000 characters at most.
errors.link: The link must be a web address starting with http:// or https://.
errors.openApplication: You already have an application in progress.
errors.invalid: This activation code is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.used: This activation code was already used.
errors.revoked: This activation code was withdrawn. Ask our team for a new one.
errors.expired: This activation code has expired. Ask our team for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

closed.byAdmin: Your previous store was closed by spellPrint
closed.again: You can apply again to open a new one.

adminCommission.title: Commission
adminCommission.subtitle: The share of every seller sale the platform keeps: one rate for all sellers.
adminCommission.text: Share of each seller sale kept by spellPrint: product price after discounts, shipping excluded. A change only applies to orders placed afterwards.
adminCommission.label: Platform commission
adminCommission.saved: Commission saved. It applies to new orders only.
adminCommission.invalid: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (2 decimals at most).
adminCommission.loadFailed: The commission settings couldn't be loaded.
adminCommission.neverSet: Never changed: the default rate applies.
adminCommission.example: Example: on a 100 DT sale, spellPrint keeps {{rate}} DT and the seller earns {{seller}} DT.

adminSellers.title: Sellers
adminSellers.subtitle: Sellers' access, their balances and the payouts made to them.

list.title: Sellers
list.text: Open a store to record a payout or suspend the seller.

payout.title: Payouts
payout.text: There is no automatic transfer: once you've paid the seller (bank transfer, cash…), record it here with its reference. It settles their whole available balance.

access.title: Seller access
access.suspendText: A suspended store no longer shows on the seller's profile and they lose their dashboard; their products stay for sale and their earnings are kept.
access.closedText: This store was deleted. Its earnings stay payable; to sell again, the user applies again.
access.deleteText: The store is deleted entirely (name, description, logo, banner) and seller access ends; their products stay for sale. Only possible once their earnings are paid out. The reason is kept in the audit log. They can apply again later.
access.unpaidEarnings: This seller still has earnings to receive: record their payout before deleting the store.

applications.title: Seller applications
applications.subtitle: Review the users who asked to sell. Approving one makes an activation code to send them.
applications.reasonHint: They will be able to apply again.

code.title: Activation code
code.share: Send this code to the applicant: they enter it on their "Become a seller" page. It works only for their account, once.
code.copyFailed: The browser didn't allow copying: select the code and copy it by hand.
code.regenerateText: The current code will stop working.
code.revokeText: It will stop working. You can make a new one later.
code.instructions:
Hello {{name}},

Your application to sell on spellPrint as "{{store}}" is approved!

To activate your seller account, sign in with your account and open:
{{url}}

Then enter this activation code: {{code}}

It works only for your account, once, until {{date}}.

See you soon,
The spellPrint team

applications.deleteText: Delete the application "{{name}}" and its activation codes? Seller access already granted is untouched.
applications.currentStore: The store as it is now: the seller may have edited it since applying.

adminAudit.title: Audit log
adminAudit.subtitle: Sensitive marketplace actions, newest first.
adminAudit.clearText: Every entry is deleted for good. A single entry will stay, saying who cleared the log.
adminAudit.deleteEntryText: "{{action}}" will be deleted from the log for good.

revenue.title: Platform revenue
revenue.subtitle: What the marketplace brings in: spellPrint's commission, apart from the sellers' earnings and the gross sales.

kpi.commissionHint: {{collected}} on paid orders · {{pending}} on unpaid ones

revenue.note: Gross sales are what customers paid for sellers' items (shipping excluded); only the commission is spellPrint's revenue. Cash on delivery: amounts become collected once orders are delivered. {{sellers}} active sellers, default rate {{rate}}%.
revenue.trendHint: By order date; refunds on the day they were made.
revenue.bySellerHint: Click a seller to see only their figures.
revenue.noSales: No seller sales in this period.
revenue.transactionsHint: Every seller item and refund, with the rate it was charged at.

kpi.pendingHint: On orders not delivered yet: paid on delivery

overview.title: Hello {{name}}
overview.subtitle: Your store at a glance.
overview.pendingOrders: {{count}} order(s) with your products are on their way
overview.trendHint: By order date, refunds taken off.
overview.topHint: In this period, by units sold.
overview.noSales: No sales in this period yet.

products.title: My products
products.subtitle: What each product sold and earned. Hide one to take it out of the store.
products.empty: You have no products yet: create one in the designer with your designs.
products.priceText: Price of "{{name}}". Leave empty to follow the shop's price list.
products.priceInvalid: Enter a price between 0 and 10000, or leave it empty.
products.deleteText: Delete "{{name}}"? Its past orders and earnings are kept.

designs.title: My designs
designs.subtitle: Your artwork, and the products using it.
designs.printNote: Upload print-ready artwork: transparent background (PNG), high resolution. It can then be placed on T-shirts and sweatshirts in the designer.
designs.empty: You haven't shared any designs yet.
designs.emptyText: Upload your first artwork to use it on your products.
designs.deleteUsed: "{{name}}" is used on {{count}} product(s): deleting it removes its image from them. Hiding it is safer. Delete anyway?

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Orders holding your products. Only your items are shown.
orders.empty: No orders with your products yet.
orders.fulfillment: spellPrint prints and ships every order: follow their progress here. Your earnings become available once an order is delivered.

earnings.title: Earnings & payouts
earnings.subtitle: How your sales turn into earnings, and what was paid to you.
earnings.availableHint: Delivered orders, not paid out yet
earnings.breakdownHint: Each sale keeps the rate of the day it was ordered.
earnings.transactionsHint: Every item sold and every refund, with its commission.
earnings.payoutsHint: Transfers made to you by spellPrint. Nothing is paid automatically.

store.title: Store settings
store.subtitle: Your store's name, description and logo, shown to customers.
store.locked: Your commission rate and seller status are managed by spellPrint.
store.onlineText: Your products are in the shop.
store.pausedText: Your store page is hidden until you reopen it; your products stay for sale. Your dashboard stays open.
store.pauseText: Your store page is hidden until you reopen it; your products stay for sale. Orders go on as usual.
store.pausedBanner: Your store is paused: its page is hidden, your products stay for sale.
store.deleteText: Your store is deleted entirely (name, description, logo, banner) and your seller access ends; your products stay for sale. Only possible once all your earnings are paid out. Your customer account stays, and you can apply again later.
store.unpaidEarnings: You still have earnings to receive: your store can be deleted once they are paid out to you.
store.deleteConfirmText: This can't be undone. To reopen a store you'll need to apply again.
